keywords: 不可恢复公钥的链上存储以支持后量子迁移
ERC-8117 防投毒的地址压缩显示格式
链上分析与隐私协议去匿名之辨
summary: SirSpudlington 指出多数后量子签名不支持公钥恢复，交易需每次附带公钥或存进合约，提议配合 EIP-7932 在链上存储公钥。xinbenlv 提出 ERC-8117 地址压缩显示格式，用于防范地址投毒。pcaversaccio 总结 SEAL 911 的 2025 年：1800 多张工单、125 多个作战室、挽回约 9500 万美元。

items.title: Magicians：不可恢复账户公钥的链上存储
items.note: （SirSpudlington）04:54：大多数非对称密码不支持从签名恢复公钥，后量子迁移时要么每笔交易附带公钥，要么存进合约，方案假定与 EIP-7932 一同打包。
items.title_en: Magicians: Storage of non-recoverable account keys on chain
items.note_en: (SirSpudlington), 04:54: most asymmetric schemes cannot recover the public key from a signature, so post-quantum migration must either attach the key to every transaction or store it in a contract, assuming bundling with EIP-7932.

keywords_en: Onchain storage of non-recoverable account keys for post-quantum migration
ERC-8117 an anti poisoning compressed address display format
chain analysis versus deanonymizing a privacy protocol
summary_en: SirSpudlington noted most post-quantum signatures cannot recover public keys, so transactions must carry the key or store it in a contract, and proposed onchain key storage alongside EIP-7932. xinbenlv proposed ERC-8117, a compressed address display format against address poisoning. pcaversaccio summed up SEAL 911's 2025: 1.8k+ tickets, 125+ war rooms and about $95M saved.
